Hi Alice —

Great to meet you earlier, and thanks for the clear list. I've summarized answers below and attached a short SOC 2 summary for your review. If helpful, we can also share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report under an NDA.

Summary (high level):
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in 2025; we can provide a summary.pdf now and a redacted report under NDA. (See attached: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf)
- Admin activity logs: we log user and admin actions (create/update/delete of org settings, role changes, policy updates) with user id, action, timestamp, and request context. Retention: default 90 days in the console; configurable to longer windows for Dedicated/Private deployments.
- API logs: full request/response metadata and token usage are available via the Console and export APIs. We capture request id, endpoint, auth identity, latency, and status codes.
- Exportability: logs can be exported to S3 (parquet/JSON), downloaded as CSV, or streamed via our logging API.
- Immutability: for Dedicated and Private customers we support WORM-like exports (write-once S3 exports) and can enable append-only storage options; hosted customers get tamper-evident audit trails and signed log digests on request.
- GDPR/HIPAA: we offer data processing addendum (DPA) and are willing to sign a BAA for covered workloads (for Private/Dedicated deployments we commonly support HIPAA workloads).

Next steps I propose:
1) I will start filling out your questionnaire and return the first pass by EOD Friday.
2) Share SOC 2 summary now (attached). If you want the full report, let's sign an NDA; I can loop Legal.
3) Schedule a 30-min technical deep-dive with Aditya to go over exports and immutability controls.

Proposed times: Thu 2/26 10:00-10:30 PT or Mon 3/2 11:00-11:30 PT. Which works for your team?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Audit logging follow-up / vendor questionnaire

Marissa / Ben —

Adding a few technical details to the thread you can share with Acme:

- Admin activity logs: structured JSON events stored in our internal logging pipeline. Each event contains: timestamp (ISO8601), actor (internal user id / external service principal), action, resource, request_id, and source_ip. We also include surge context (session id) for multi-step operations.
- API logs: captured at the edge with request/response metadata and forwarded to our observability cluster; retention policy applied at the storage layer.
- Export formats: JSON Lines (recommended), Parquet (for analytics), CSV (summary exports). Exports can be scheduled to S3 buckets with region selection.
- Immutability: for customers who require WORM, we support S3 Object Lock on export buckets for Dedicated/Private; for Hosted, we provide signed hash digests of log snapshots stored off-line for audit verification.
- Timeline for questionnaire: I can take the technical sections; give me until EOD next Wed (3/4) to complete technical answers and export samples.

Also noting: if Acme needs a longer retention window (e.g., 1 year), we can provision a retention policy on Dedicated or route logs to a customer-managed S3 for cheaper longer-term retention.

-Aditya
Principal Engineer, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference
